Invalidates the chunk-5h 'deterministic row-by-row diff at 4x sims' design; salvageable for the chunk-5i verdict (state-identical subset still yielded a 95% CI well below the 30% LIVES threshold) but invalidates any future sim-count A/B comparison until fixed.
